name: Moroccan Turkey Meatball Stew with Cauliflower-Carrot Sauté & Herbs

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium head cauliflower
4 medium carrots
1 small bunch cilantro
1 small pkg fresh mint
2 sticks celery
4 tomatoes
1 lemon

instructions.primary_message: Cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower; place in a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl with the cauliflower and set aside.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; pick mint leaves off the stems. Discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half of the herbs in another medium bowl and set remainder aside for serving.

Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the herbs along with turkey and spices. Using your hands, mix well to combine. Using a tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 cloves garlic
1 ½ lb ground turkey
2 tsp cumin, ground
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs and cook, turning often, until just browned on all sides, 4-5 minutes (the meatballs will not be cooked all the way through). Once done, transfer to a clean plate. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and small dice onion; trim and small dice celery.
Return the skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and celery; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies start to soften, about 3 minutes.
While the veggies are cooking, medium dice tomatoes; add to the skillet along with the tomato sauce, water, and spices. Stir to combine and bring the stew to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (8 oz) cans tomato sauce
1 cup water
1 tsp cumin, ground
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the stew is boiling, reduce heat to medium, then return meatballs (and any accumulated juices) to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until meatballs are cooked through, 5-6 minutes more.
Meanwhile, preheat another large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the second skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add cauliflower, carrot, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring often, until cauliflower is lightly golden and cooked through, 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the meatballs are done, juice lemon into the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide cauliflower-carrot sauté and meatball stew between plates or bowls; sprinkle with reserved herbs and enjoy!
